LEARN MORE Decline Accept Cookies English Sign In Search for Jobs Introduce Yourself Private Credit Product Solutioning Lead, VP page is loaded Private Credit Product Solutioning Lead, VP Apply locations Boston, Massachusetts Quincy, Massachusetts time type Full time posted on Posted 30+ Days Ago time left to apply End Date: May 31, 2026 (1 day left to apply) job requisition id R-789238 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on State Street to help them manage risk, respond to challenges through solutions, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged professionals are essential to our success. Our commitment to maintain an environment where every employee feels valued and able to meet their full potential infuses our company values. It’s also part of our commitment to inclusion, development and engagement, and corporate social responsibility. You’ll have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.   Join us. Position Overview Private Credit has been the fastest growing sub-segment of the Private Markets industry over the past several years.  This is expected to continue as more firms see direct/private lending as a way to create portfolio yields that are uncorrelated to public markets; as traditional lending banks continue to face capital constraints and overheads; and as insurance companies seek structured loans and yields to feed their annuity businesses.  In addition to direct lending, the definition of Private Credit continues to expand to other areas such Real Estate, Infrastructure and other areas of Asset Based Financing. Private Credit as an asset class also lends itself to multiple jurisdictions and various structures, including traditional closed ended funds, private hybrid funds, SMAs and registered semi-liquid fund structures such BDC’s, Interval Funds, ELTIF’s, etc which will result in broader distribution of these products into wealth channels, and thus more growth. This Vice President position will report to the Managing Director of Private Credit Product in State Street’s institutional services division.  The position will also collaborate closely with operating teams providing fund administration, loan services, custody, transfer agency, trustee services and analytics to credit managers.  Additionally the position will collaborate with State Street’s global markets credit lending and finance team to combine on client value chain strategies across asset servicing and credit finance. The Private Credit Product Solutioning Lead role will have responsibility for contributing to  the evolution and evangelism of our go-to-market strategy for asset servicing capabilities superior to global competitors in all major regions, and will have a key role in the firm’s ability to capture the above-mentioned growth levels.  Responsibilities                             Client solutioning and continuing to grow our Private Credit offering are the main responsibilities of this role, as well as participation in the product development and management of the private credit end to end platform. You will collaborate closely with commercial teams and operating teams to drive superior outcomes for State Street and our global private equity clients . Provide subject matter expertise - have a solid understanding of the end-to-end Private Credit strategic operating model and technology stack. Ability to develop solutions that can be deployed for complex clients Drive solutions - partner with teams across our global organization to define and solution critical deals and to ensure that the relevant subject matter experts are consulted, and that critical design assumptions and strategic options are thoroughly explored Research & Market Analysis - Ensure key competitor intelligence is updated continuously, and emerging industry trends are captured where relevant Partner with the business development and relationship management organizations to develop a robust pipeline. Drive business development, including providing support in Request for Information / Proposals, ensuring quality responses. Job Requirements and Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required (Finance, Business or Accounting preferred) 7+ years experience desirable Private Credit experience needed; either from asset servicing, or directly from within Private Credit and Fund employers Critical thinking, problem solving, and decision making skills Demonstrable experience managing projects and collaborating across teams Are you the right candidate? Yes! We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit. About State Street What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients. Work, Live and Grow. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential. Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility. We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you. State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Salary Range: $110,000 - $207,500 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical rigor, a clear understanding of regulatory and risk data needs, and the ability to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into well‑defined, implementable solutions. Why this role is important to us Given the enterprise‑wide reliance on risk data for reporting to management, committees, and regulators, this role is vital to protecting the firm from data‑related risk and ensuring that ERM Risk IT delivers trusted, well‑controlled risk data platforms This role plays an important role in maintaining risk data warehouse as well as onboarding new data feeds for newly onboarded product offering or booking site. What you will be responsible for As an AVP Business Analyst within ERM Risk IT, you will play a critical role in shaping, governing, and enabling the firm’s Risk Data Repository and related risk data platforms. You will be responsible for ensuring that business, regulatory, and risk requirements are clearly defined, traceable, and translated into high‑quality, well‑controlled technology solutions. Your responsibilities will include Lead the analysis and definition of business and regulatory requirements for the Risk Data Repository and its upstream and downstream consumers write Technical FSDs, use case docs Conduct Walkthrough within IT team (Developers and SQA team members) Conduct functional testing Work with new source systems for new service onboarding Writing Source to Target mapping specifications Identify opportunities to improve requirement quality, data governance, and analysis practices within ERM Risk IT. Contribute to the evolution of standard templates, data definitions, and best practices for risk data analysis What we value These skills will help you succeed in this role A commitment to accuracy, consistency, and clarity in risk data definitions, mappings, and requirements. We value analysts who understand that small ambiguities in data or rules can translate into material risk at the enterprise level. An appreciation for operating in a highly regulated environment, where requirements must be well‑documented, traceable, and defensible. We value a mindset that naturally considers auditability, lineage, and evidence. Analysts who take responsibility for ensuring requirements are complete, understood, and implemented as intended—from initial analysis through delivery and adoption. The ability to evaluate complex problems, challenge assumptions constructively, and apply sound judgment when navigating trade‑offs between business needs, regulatory expectations, and technical constraints. The ability to articulate complex risk and data concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, including Risk, Technology, Audit, and senior stakeholders. A collaborative approach that builds trust across Risk, Technology, Architecture, and Delivery teams. We value individuals who can influence outcomes without formal authority. The ability to think methodically and at the same time understand the broader enterprise risk context in which the Risk Data Repository operates. An interest in improving how risk data requirements are captured, governed, and delivered, contributing to stronger platforms and more resilient risk capabilities over time Good Knowledge of financial products Education & Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Risk Management, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline . Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or equivalent) is preferred but not required. 8–12+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Senior Analyst supporting enterprise technology initiatives in a regulated financial services environment. Strong experience working with risk data, reference data, or enterprise data platforms , preferably supporting ERM, Credit Risk, Market Risk, Liquidity Risk, or Regulatory Reporting functions. Demonstrated experience supporting initiatives driven by regulatory requirements, audit findings, or remediation programs . Solid understanding of risk data governance, data lineage, data quality, and control concepts , including expectations aligned with risk data aggregation and reporting principles (e.g., BCBS 239). Experience translating complex business and regulatory needs into functional requirements, data specifications, business rules, and validation criteria . Familiarity with large‑scale data platforms and architectures (e.g., data warehouses, data lakes, inbound/outbound data feeds). Experience partnering with Risk, Compliance, Audit, Technology, Architecture, and Data Engineering teams in a matrixed environment. Strong documentation skills, with experience producing artifacts suitable for regulatory review and audit scrutiny . Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders. Experience working in Agile, hybrid, or structured delivery models . LEARN MORE Decline Accept Cookies English Sign In Search for Jobs Introduce Yourself Project Manager – AVP page is loaded Project Manager – AVP Apply locations Boston, Massachusetts Quincy, Massachusetts time type Full time posted on Posted 30 Days Ago time left to apply End Date: May 31, 2026 (1 day left to apply) job requisition id R-788939 Who we are looking for We are looking for a seasoned AVP‑level Project Manager, reporting directly to Program Director with a strong track record of delivering complex ERM Risk IT initiatives in a highly regulated financial services environment. The ideal candidate combines execution discipline with sound judgment, is comfortable operating in ambiguity, and can lead cross‑functional teams through regulatory‑driven change while maintaining platform stability. Why this role is important to us ERM Risk IT plays a critical role in supporting the firm’s enterprise risk management framework by delivering platforms, data, and controls that underpin regulatory compliance, risk monitoring, and decision‑making across the organization. The work delivered by ERM Risk IT is highly visible, tightly governed, and often subject to regulatory scrutiny, audit review, and senior management oversight. This AVP Project Manager role is essential to ensuring that complex, risk‑critical initiatives are delivered with rigor, transparency, and predictable outcomes . Many ERM Risk IT programs—such as regulatory remediation, risk data platforms, model and reference data systems, and cloud modernization—carry firm‑wide impact and strict delivery expectations. Failure to execute effectively can result in regulatory exposure, control weaknesses, or downstream operational risk. What you will be responsible for As an AVP Project Manager within ERM Risk IT, you will be responsible for providing senior delivery leadership across complex, risk‑critical technology initiatives that support the firm’s enterprise risk management framework. Your responsibilities will include; End‑to‑End Delivery Ownership Own the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple concurrent ERM Risk IT initiatives, including regulatory remediation, risk data platforms, cloud migration, and platform modernization programs. Translate regulatory commitments, business objectives, and risk priorities into clear, executable delivery plans. Ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within agreed scope, and in line with enterprise governance standards. Program Governance & Control Establish and run appropriate delivery governance, including status reviews, tollgates, and escalation forums. Proactively identify delivery risks, constraints, and inter‑program dependencies, and drive mitigation strategies. Maintain strong execution discipline, ensuring scope control, dependency management, and change governance. Regulatory, Risk & Audit Delivery Manage initiatives linked to regulatory findings, audit observations, and control enhancements, ensuring clear ownership through closure. Do you thrive on solving complex customer challenges and delivering solutions that truly differentiate an organization in the marketplace? Are you passionate about understanding customer needs and translating them into innovative business capabilities and platforms? Are you excited by the opportunity to institutionalize business architecture and shape the future of investment management through transformative, customer-centric solutions? Do you seek out opportunities to work across product, platform, and service teams, influencing outcomes and building consensus in a dynamic, matrixed organization? As a Business Architect, VP at State Street Investment Management (“State Street IM”, formerly known as State Street Global Advisors or SSGA), you will play a key role in developing, maturing, and institutionalizing the business architecture function. This role is critical to aligning business capabilities, processes, and operating models with evolving business strategy and will be central to the firm’s transformation toward a Product, Platform, and Service (PPS) operating model. You will work closely with the Head of Business Architecture, business leaders, solution architects, and technology teams to help the organization transform to a PPS operating model, powered by a strong business architecture strategy that aligns business outcomes to platform and capability roadmaps. This is foundational to establishing an end-to-end business platform and business architecture for our overall investment management business. Key Responsibilities Support the establishment and maturation of a scalable business architecture function that enables enterprise-wide transformation. Design and maintain business capability models, value streams, and operating models aligned with strategic objectives. Partner with business and technology leaders to ensure alignment between business strategy, operating models, and technology investments. Contribute to the adoption of the PPS operating model by embedding business architecture principles and frameworks. Provide business architectural oversight and thought leadership for transformation initiatives and strategic programs. Develop and maintain business architecture deliverables such as capability maps, value stream diagrams, and investment roadmaps. Support strategic planning, innovation, and change management efforts across the organization. Collaborate with solution architects, product managers, and delivery teams to ensure business outcomes are realized. Mentor and support junior business architects, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in business architecture, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or strategic transformation roles, preferably within investment management or financial services. Proven track record of supporting business architecture functions in complex, matrixed organizations. Strong expertise in business capability modeling, value stream mapping, operating model design, and enterprise transformation. Technical proficiency in solution architecture , including experience collaborating with solution architects on integration patterns, API management, microservices, and composable architecture. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including cloud-native solution design, data integration, and security best practices. Experience with business capability software catalog tools and relevant governance. GenAI expertise preferred: familiarity with generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, responsible AI practices, and integrating AI/ML capabilities into business processes. Experience supporting large-scale transformation initiatives, including PPS or similar operating models. Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, BIZBOK, ArchiMate, or similar. Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into actionable technology and data solutions. Excellent communication, facilitation, and strategic thinking skills. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, navigate organizational complexity, and drive measurable outcomes. Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, computer science, engineering, or technology required; MBA or advanced degree preferred. Through our commitment to product quality and operating through a client-focused lens, we’ve experienced continuous growth. Charles River IMS is strategically aligned to innovate the future of investment management technologies. Together with State Street’s middle and back office capabilities, Charles River’s cloud-deployed software technology forms the foundation of State Street Alpha℠. The Chares River Development Post-Trade team is looking to hire a Senior Business Analyst who will be responsible for working with clients and development to create solutions to improve the client experience, the product feature set, and the strategic position of the CRD Investment Management System. Why this job is important to us Charles River Development brings together data and capabilities across the investment lifecycle to help our clients make better decisions, grow at scale, and deliver returns for their clients. Our diverse team of highly skilled technologists and professionals are agile thinkers and problem solvers, committed to our end users and engineering excellence. We use mentorship and teamwork to impact and drive our business forward every day. By joining the Post-Trade team, you will use advanced technology and critical thinking to challenge the status quo and drive results. What you are responsible for The Senior Business Analyst will become a Charles River product expert and help to ensure that our software products effectively aid our end users with their trading and front office workflows. In consultation with our financial industry clients and internal product teams, they will utilize business and technical knowledge to improve product performance and competitive advantages. The Senior Business Analyst will work on post-trade matching and settlement workflows across all instrument types (equity, fixed income, derivatives, FX, etc.), participating in the full software development lifecycle and contributing as the Product Owner of a feature-focused product development team They must be familiar with both financial and technical concepts, with a strong ability to deliver against specific requirements in a timely fashion on a project-by-project basis. Responsibilities: Research and produce business and technical requirement documents Analyze the front, middle and back-office workflows and produce detailed functional documents. Work directly with customers and product management teams to gather product requirements and develop feature specifications; involvement in all aspects of the software product life cycle Apply detailed knowledge of business requirements and workflows to assist in product development Partner with development to help develop, implement, and refine features Plan and schedule validation tasks; provide hands-on manual tests; develop verification plans and processes Provide feedback on product performance Review documentation to ensure accurate and complete documentation Provide client beta testing support and train personnel on capabilities of new product releases Assist with the management of project schedules and deliverables Assist implementation and support to troubleshoot, reproduce and resolve escalated client issues Actively participate in the Agile Scrum as the Product Owner and run the grooming meetings, review the completed work in sprint demos, track progress in standups and plan the sprints with Dev lead. Create Jiras, maintain prioritized backlog, release plans and roadmap. Work closely with QA, review and approve QA test plans and test results. Coordination with cross functional teams to complete the project on-time and release the product. Requirements: 10+ years of software development lifecycle experience, particularly Agile Scrum methodology preferred 5+ years of hands-on experience with post-trade matching and settlement product development is a must Strong understanding of the post-trade matching vendor workflows, FIX workflows and settlement workflows with SWIFT messages Experience building integrations with third party vendors Experience with MSSQL preferred Familiarity with various types of financial instruments (Equity, Fixed Income, Derivatives etc.) Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including negotiation skills Advanced writing skills, including the ability to abstract/summarize highly detailed information Strong analytical skills, including the ability to reconcile conflicting data Ability to translate customer business needs into application requirements Strong technical background and ability to come up with technical solution Demonstrated planning, prioritization and scheduling skills Ability to independently ramp up and proactively resolve impediments to make progress. LEARN MORE Decline Accept Cookies English Sign In Search for Jobs Introduce Yourself Alpha Operations Client Pathways, Vice President page is loaded Alpha Operations Client Pathways, Vice President Apply locations Quincy, Massachusetts time type Full time posted on Posted 30+ Days Ago time left to apply End Date: May 31, 2026 (1 day left to apply) job requisition id R-778801 Who we are looking for In this role as Vice President - Alpha Operations Client Pathways, you will work with State Street teams from around the globe to lead a team or multiple teams supporting the transformation of some of State Street’s key middle office clients. You will have leadership and strategy responsibility to oversee and deliver all day-to-day responsibilities of your teams in a fast-paced, flexible and exciting environment. The role will need to initiate and develop good communication and interpersonal relationships with operations, technology and client relationship teams  to ensure any change initiatives maintain the high level of service that is currently being provided to these clients. Why this role is important to us This is a transformation and managerial position with significant change the bank’s responsibility within Middle Office Services. This is a project lead with oversight responsibilities of a functional area, managing both direct reports and cross functional teams. Responsibilities include oversight of business analysis, solutions design and implementation, working closely with client and technology partners. In addition to operational and team responsibilities, this role is client facing, and acts as a primary escalation point for all program/project related items both internally at State Street and with the client. The candidate should be a hands-on leader who is required to ensure the team(s) under their responsibility undertake appropriate learning, analysis, documentation and implementation practices, ensure timely response to client-initiated queries, and escalation of any potential risks or issues which will impact our change delivery. What you will be responsible for Critical business priorities: Drive forward workstreams within a large client facing strategic initiative with Alpha Operations Manage and drive Business Analysis and Testing activities, both personally and leading a team Be accountable for deliverable and tollgate timelines, documentation and presentation Ensure a robust control environment is built into any model evolutions being designed Role Definition: Leader will be responsible for driving our team's evaluation of current operating models and designing, documenting and executing upon a market leading future state operating model Understand existing business and technology structures and operating models at State Street including hand offs, process flow and delivery across both client facing sites and operations hubs Develop large scale transformation strategies to overhaul and redesign the operating model to focus on client experience, automation, efficiency and process improvements using best in class tools Collaborate with Operations, Transformation, and Technology teams to ensure the core pillars of the program are understood, adopted and operational requirements are clear and tested. Assess performance of the program against benefit and outcome targets (Financial & non-financial), manage risks and issues and take corrective measurements. Partner with client, operations and program leadership to execute on these process re-engineering changes globally As a Vice President, we require strong leadership and advanced skills in areas such as: Ability to navigate a large, global organization. Build meaningful relationships and develop an effective network. Work successfully in a matrixed environment. Effectively manage multiple stakeholders, determine highest priorities for the organization, identify and resolve contention between directives. Proven leadership skills as well as managing and developing a high performing team. Excellent time management, presentation and communication skills to effectively reach multiple reporting levels (clients, other 3rd parties, executives, peers, subordinates). Flexibility across multiple communication formats Proven track record of achieving/exceeding financial goals through expense discipline and headcount management. Experience with change management programs in sponsorship, leadership roles. Demonstrated ability to execute under challenging circumstances and deliver targeted outcomes. Demonstrated ability to manage, coach and influence colleagues and virtual team members.  Cross-cultural awareness and the ability to connect with colleagues globally in a collaborative, open work environment. Serve as a role model of acceptance and flexibility in dealing with colleagues with varying backgrounds. The candidate for the Vice President Alpha Operations Client Pathways role will possess and/or be able to demonstrate: A proven track record at a senior level in client facing role such as business and IT relationship management, account management, delivery executive, or related disciplines with Executive level reporting experience 15 years + experience in financial services presently in a leadership role, having managed large scale transformation roles. Deep understanding of the Corporate Investment Banking landscape, with experience leading operational teams within the Middle Office space Strong Stakeholder and Relationship Management skills In-depth understanding of the linkage between information technology and business value Operations experience program managing large scale initiatives and implementations Strategic thinker with an ability to effectively partner with Operations and Transformation leads, technology partners and senior management Creative and analytical ability in problem resolution and troubleshooting Collaborative leadership and work style Salary Range: $115,000 - $197,500 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. In this role you will interface with engineering teams, product management, business units and customers to define and deliver robust, scalable and agile architectures in support of the rapidly growing product capabilities. You will lead teams to plan, design, build and participate in deploying Microsoft technology infrastructures in the Azure Public Cloud. This role focuses on the architecture of the foundational cloud infrastructure, shared services, and DevOps processes and tooling that will underpin the next generation platform. This includes storage, compute, networking and services deployed across the globe and with a strong, forward-looking security architecture for a growing range of compliance standards. Job Requirements: Responsible for Cloud Platform Engineering for a technical domain or initiative, working with multiple scrum teams, engineering managers and architects to deliver a well-architected, principled technology platform. Deep knowledge and hands on implementation experience on Azure Infrastructure and cloud services. Proficiency in Microsoft Azure IAAS/PAAS services like Azure Virtual Machines (VMs), Virtual Network (VNET), Firewall, Azure Storage, Key Vault, DNS, Application Gateway, Load Balancer, App Service, API Gateway. Experience working with Active Directory, Azure Active Directory/Entra ID, Lightweight Directory Access Protocol, IAM permissions on Management Groups, subscriptions, and resources. Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights for performance and reliability management. Strong PowerShell, Bash, REST API or Python scripting skills for automating tasks and processes To Provide cloud engineering support for build, migration and operation of Azure cloud infrastructure Research and evaluate emerging cloud technologies and proactively recommend areas where they can bring business value. Develop aspects of the cloud migration initiative, including its impact on infrastructure, networks and security. Define standards and best practices by conducting POCs for new cloud technologies leveraged by the development organization and engineering teams. Ensure that all cloud solutions follow security and compliance controls. Participate in the establishment on an automated DevOps release management pipeline which delivers tooling for next generation application development efforts and on-going production operations. Cultivate a Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery mind set. Provide thought leadership on cloud platform technology use, design and implementation. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a Technical or Analytical field required, Master’s preferred. Azure Cloud Platform Certification preferred. Five years or more of cloud / infrastructure experience. Demonstrated Azure deployment experience. Deep understanding of Microsoft Azure technologies and services. Working experience with global azure deployments. Working experience with highly segmented networks in public and private clouds. Working experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies in Azure. Prior enterprise cloud architecture/design experience a huge plus. Excellent communication, documentation and troubleshooting skills. An innovative approach to work, constantly looking to upgrade the system to more efficient and effective new technologies and processes. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. This role will oversee a group of professionals responsible for designing and executing regulatory and controls testing to assess State Street’s adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. Financial Crimes risks include, but are not limited to, money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and sanctions evasion. As a key member of our global team, you will be accountable for: Developing and managing a comprehensive, risk-based testing plan Leading the execution of strategically significant testing initiatives Driving collaboration across business units to strengthen compliance frameworks This position is ideal for an individual with experience in risk assessment, internal controls, compliance testing or audit functions, particularly covering Financial Crimes. This role is based in Boston, Massachusetts. Working model is 4 days onsite, 1 day remotely. Why this role is important to us The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for. What you will be responsible for As the Head of Financial Crimes Compliance Testing of you will: Lead a global, diverse testing team effectively managing resources across multiple geographies to deliver on critical testing commitments Oversee the development of the annual testing plan in partnership with subject matter experts, ensuring comprehensive coverage of high-risk areas and coordination with the first and third lines of defense to avoid redundancies Apply the department’s established methodology to independently design approaches for assessing the risk of non-compliance with regulatory obligations and policy requirements, and validate State Street’s adherence to applicable regulations Direct the performance of process walkthroughs and design of testing activities for compliance areas deemed as high priority Serve as the primary representative of the testing team as it pertains to Financial Crimes, engaging with global stakeholders at all organizational levels to foster collaboration and alignment Write well-reasoned and technically sound reports for executive consumption in accordance with internal standards to clearly communicate testing objective, scope, regulatory requirements, results, and key issues Manage relationships with corporate audit and quality assurance teams, responding to inquiries and providing documentation as necessary to demonstrate compliance with internal standards Building strong relationships with other lines of defense and testing functions across various jurisdictions to harmonize on scope and testing approaches Provide a level of mentorship and professional development while driving quality deliverables and attention to detail of the team’s work products Keep abreast of regulators’ focus areas, recent enforcement actions, and industry practices generally, serving as the subject matter expert for Financial Crimes risk exposures and regulatory requirements What we value These skills will help you succeed in this role Excellent technical writing skills Exemplary communication and relationship building skills at all levels, from senior executives to individual contributors Inclusive mindset that recognizes the value of a diverse global team and an ability to work across cultures with adaptability and flexibility Deep understanding on the importance of effectiveness and efficiency Analytical skills to evaluate business data and testing results with healthy skepticism and an ability to work in ambiguity Enthusiasm for learning and an aptitude to learn quickly, as well as the motivation to use thought leadership to continue to grow the team Strong personal drive, attention to detail and proactive initiative, coupled with urgency, responsiveness, and a commitment to continuous learning and growth Education & Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) required; Master’s Degree or J.D. preferred Significant experience designing and executing AML and Sanctions compliance monitoring, surveillance, testing, audit or exams Professional certification(s) such as Certified Anti Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) and Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) preferred Other professional certification(s) such as, Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM), Certified Risk Professional (CRP), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) are favorable Salary Range: $110,000 - $207,500 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. LEARN MORE Decline Accept Cookies English Sign In Search for Jobs Introduce Yourself Shareholder Services Operations Transformation, Officer - State Street Investment Management page is loaded Shareholder Services Operations Transformation, Officer - State Street Investment Management Apply locations Quincy, Massachusetts time type Full time posted on Posted 30+ Days Ago time left to apply End Date: July 31, 2026 (30+ days left to apply) job requisition id R-783502 State Street Investment Management, the asset management division of State Street Corporation, is actively hiring a Shareholder Services Operations Transformation Officer. This officer-level position will report to the Head of North America Shareholder Services in the State Street IM office at the John Adams Building in Quincy. The Operations Transformation Officer’s primary responsibility is to drive operational change and process improvement for new and existing business, with a focus on efficiency, scalability, and global consistency. As the technology platform evolves and product innovation continues throughout the organization, there will be opportunities for this role to absorb similar processes and responsibilities from other internal teams working toward the end-state Platforms, Products, and Services operational model. A significant portion of this role will be dedicated to supporting a new fund launch for an existing client that requires non-standard operational support within the team. The Officer must be dedicated, enthusiastic, and solutions-oriented, demonstrating sound judgment on critical issues and resolutions. The ability to meet established timeline milestones is critical, as there are interdependencies across teams that must be closely managed from a risk perspective. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, along with a proven ability to drive execution across internal and external teams, are required. Job Responsibilities Successfully execute daily cash and share processing to the external custodian in support of the new WindWise Fund-of-Funds product launch. Monitor the WindWise settlement process to ensure there are no failures or reconciliation items; partner internally with the Investment Solutions Group Operations team to resolve issues related to the fund-of-funds structure. Ensure daily pricing of the WindWise Fund-of-Funds and timely release of client statements in accordance with regulatory requirements. Contribute to and manage structured change processes, ensuring changes are reviewed, authorized, implemented, and validated in a controlled manner that supports business continuity and risk-controlled transformation. Provide timely updates to project stakeholders, ensuring transparency of project status and escalation of obstacles when necessary. Collaborate to define new operational processes, within established guidelines and requirements, to support new product launches and evolving client demands. Facilitate the creation of training sessions, procedures, and job aids to support cross-training and knowledge sharing across the team. Actively and enthusiastically propose creative solutions and continuously seek ways to enhance the client experience. Enforce process standards and adherence to documented procedures. Participate in and/or lead project work related to multiple IT initiatives impacting Shareholder Services in the short, medium, and long term. Partner closely with the Shareholder Services Management Team to perform end-to-end testing for various IT initiatives. Perform other duties as required. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or equivalent work experience Minimum of five years of experience in financial services Demonstrated exceptional time-management capabilities Transfer agency knowledge and/or experience, particularly relating to commingled funds and fund-of-funds structures Ability to work effectively in a complex, global, fast-paced, hybrid work environment and deliver results quickly Strong team player with the ability to work effectively at all levels of the organization Excellent collaborative, interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills, including a professional telephone presence Strong analytical and problem-resolution skills Salary Range: $70,000 - $118,750 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. Handle sensitive and time-critical matters on behalf of the COO, ensuring focus on the highest-value priorities. jobs.role: Azure Platform Engineer, Assistant Vice President
jobs.description_text: Azure Platform Engineer, Assistant Vice President Skip to main content Click 'Accept Cookies' to confirm you are giving consent to cookies being used . LEARN MORE Decline Accept Cookies English Sign In Search for Jobs Introduce Yourself Azure Platform Engineer, Assistant Vice President page is loaded Azure Platform Engineer, Assistant Vice President Apply locations Quincy, Massachusetts time type Full time posted on Posted 10 Days Ago time left to apply End Date: June 2, 2026 (3 days left to apply) job requisition id R-784908 Who we are looking for We are looking for an experienced Azure Platform Engineer with a strong engineering background to join our Platform Engineering team in the Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE). In this position, you will play an important role in designing, building, managing, and enhancing Azure platform capabilities to support secure, compliant, and scalable workloads across State Street. You will be instrumental in building the Azure foundation by establishing platform standards, reusable infrastructure patterns, and automation-focused solutions that meet enterprise security, governance, and regulatory needs. This role requires a strong engineering mindset, deep understanding of Azure cloud concepts, and hands-on experience in delivering production-grade platform solutions using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). The ideal candidate is a problem solver and platform builder, someone who is passionate about cloud engineering, embraces automation, and thrives in a collaborative environment where innovation, reliability, and security are paramount. What you will be responsible for As an Azure Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating secure, scalable, and resilient Azure platform capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate workloads confidently within State Street’s cloud ecosystem. Your responsibilities will span platform architecture, service enablement, automation, operations, and collaboration, with a strong focus on engineering excellence and cloud best practices. Platform Design & Engineering Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure Azure infrastructure solutions aligned with enterprise security, governance, and resiliency standards. Partner closely with platform architects to define component responsibilities, drive platform evolution, and ensure platform services meet current and future business needs. Leverage native Azure services to meet the firm’s performance, availability, resiliency, and regulatory requirements. Azure Service Enablement & Governance Enable Azure services and platform capabilities based on use‑case‑driven requirements, ensuring standardized, compliant, and reusable implementations. Drive identity, access management, configuration management, and monitoring strategies across the Azure platform. Ensure platform designs adhere to security-by-design and least-privilege principles. Infrastructure as Code & Automation Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and scripting languages to automate deployment of Azure resource stacks and configurations. Create automation solutions across all phases of the SDLC, including provisioning, configuration, validation, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Continuously improve platform automation to enhance reliability, repeatability, and operational efficiency. Collaboration & Workload Enablement Collaborate closely with software development leads and application teams to understand workload requirements and guide them on optimal use of Azure services. Provide architectural guidance to help teams optimize for performance, cost efficiency, scalability, and architectural flexibility. Work with software testers and quality engineers to ensure the platform supports both automated and manual testing needs. Operations, Monitoring & Support Monitor platform health and proactively troubleshoot and resolve issues identified through monitoring tools and enterprise ticketing systems. Ensure issues are fully documented, including root cause analysis, actions taken, and clear resolution steps. Contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes, observability, and platform reliability. Continuous Improvement Actively contribute to the continuous evolution of the Azure platform , driving improvements in architecture, automation, security, governance, and operational excellence. Identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, and modernize Azure platform components, reusable modules, and service enablement patterns. Continuously enhance Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and operational tooling to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and speed. Leverage operational insights, monitoring data, and incident learnings to strengthen platform resiliency, observability, and self‑healing capabilities . Stay current with Azure service innovations, cloud-native patterns, and industry best practices , and proactively assess their applicability to the enterprise platform. Contribute to the development and refinement of platform standards, reference architectures, guardrails, and engineering best practices within the Cloud Center of Excellence. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation-first thinking, and continuous learning within the Azure Platform Engineering team. Support ongoing efforts to improve developer experience, cost optimization, and platform scalability , enabling application teams to move faster while remaining secure and compliant. What we value The following skills and attributes will help you succeed and thrive in this role: Strong hands-on experience with Azure IaaS in enterprise-scale environments, enabling secure, compliant, and scalable cloud platforms. An automation-first, engineering mindset , with a passion for building repeatable, reliable, and resilient solutions rather than manual processes. Proven experience designing and delivering hybrid solutions across on‑premises and cloud environments for large, complex enterprises. Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns , platform design principles, and DevOps practices , with a strong emphasis on Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . Ability to apply IaC principles (Terraform) to standardize deployments, enforce governance, and improve operational efficiency. A strong learning mindset with the openness and ability to quickly adopt new technologies, tools, and cloud services in a fast‑paced environment. Self-motivated and passionate team player who takes ownership, demonstrates accountability, and consistently drives work to completion. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate ideas, collaborate across teams, and proactively escalate risks or issues in a timely and constructive manner. Education & Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline 8+ years of hands‑on IT experience , including 5+ years designing, implementing, and supporting Azure environments at enterprise scale Strong understanding of Agile delivery models and modern SDLC practices Proven experience with CI/CD and SDLC tooling , such as Azure DevOps (ADO), Harness, ServiceNow, and related platforms Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS , with strong grounding in cloud‑native architecture patterns and DevOps / Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles Hands‑on experience across one or more of the following Azure domains: Core IaaS : Compute, Storage, Networking, High Availability Azure PaaS : Azure Key Vault, AKS, Event Hubs, Azure AD Data Platforms : Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Cosmos DB Strong programming and scripting skills using Python, Shell scripting, Azure PowerShell, Azure CLI , and related tools Demonstrated experience designing, coding, and deploying Terraform and/or ARM templates , including full‑stack automation and Azure service enablement Solid understanding of Azure governance and best practices , including Azure Policy, RBAC, networking architectures, cost management, and compliance controls Working knowledge of authentication protocols , SSL/TLS communication, and automated unit and integration testing Experience with cost optimization, compliance posture improvement , and emerging Azure capabilities (e.g., Azure OpenAI) is an advantage Ability to produce well‑documented, compliant design artifacts aligned with enterprise and regulatory standards Strong verbal and written English communication skills Financial services or regulated industry experience is a strong plus Relevant Azure and cloud certifications are strongly preferred Salary Range: $90,000 - $157,500 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. Our client base includes many of the world’s largest investment and financial institutions. To better serve the growing demand for our Software as a managed service offering. This is an internal process improvement, business and technical staff position responsible for managing and supporting as an Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Systems & Automation, the candidate will work as conduit within our financial technology ecosystem working with platform engineering, product, SaaS implementation teams. This is not a "maintenance" role; the candidate is expected to be an agent of change. Candidate will scrutinize our existing manual workflows, identify structural gaps, and build the automated bridges necessary to ensure seamless, secure, and rapid software delivery implementing standard SaaS strategy. This AVP position grants the authority to challenge the status quo. The candidate will not just be using the tools but will be working and deciding how to roll out certain functionality on the SaaS platform. Responsibilities: Audit existing manual processes across the application lifecycle and design/implement automated solutions to eliminate toil. Develop and maintain robust configuration management scripts using Ansible, Python & PowerShell. Work with product/engineering teams to optimize the CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, risk-mitigated deployments of CRIMS applications. Responsible for ensuring efficiency, availability and configuration of the “CRD Development” SaaS platform by providing solutions based on sound technical knowledge. Adopt, customize and implement industry standard DevOps policies and DevOps procedures. Create and maintain automated scripts/tools that will build, configure, deploy and test applications deployed to different environments, maintain, support, and enhance continuous integration environments. Work hands on with the system, installing and configuring it and testing that it meets the product’s technical and business requirements. Work with an automated release management process for SaaS clients. Break down moderately complex processes into simple and reliable components. jobs.description_text: Head of Data Platform Engineering, MD Skip to main content Click 'Accept Cookies' to confirm you are giving consent to cookies being used . LEARN MORE Decline Accept Cookies English Sign In Search for Jobs Introduce Yourself Head of Data Platform Engineering, MD page is loaded Head of Data Platform Engineering, MD Apply locations Burlington Massachusetts time type Full time posted on Posted 30+ Days Ago time left to apply End Date: June 6, 2026 (7 days left to apply) job requisition id R-786032 Role Overview The Head of Data Platform Engineering will lead the design, build, and operation of a modern, fully cloud‑native data platform supporting enterprise‑wide analytics, data science, and AI initiatives. This role is ideal for a seasoned engineering leader with a deep background in large‑scale data systems, distributed computing, and modern cloud architectures especially Azure. The ideal candidate combines technical excellence, strategic vision, and the ability to scale teams, processes, and platforms that enable data‑driven decision making. Charles River Development empowers investment firms worldwide with a cloud-based platform that streamlines and automates the investment process across asset classes. As part of State Street Alpha®, we bring together data, technology, and services to help clients make confident decisions and scale with agility. Our open ecosystem and global support model enable investment professionals—from portfolio managers to private markets specialists—to navigate complexity and drive innovation. At Charles River, we thrive on collaboration, continuous improvement, and a shared commitment to shaping the future of financial technology. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the long‑term vision and architecture for a unified, cloud‑native data platform supporting data ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and access at scale. Lead the engineering teams building core components of the data platform: data lakehouse, real‑time streaming, metadata catalog, observability framework, and security layers. Drive selection and adoption of technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Delta Lake, Iceberg, or similar) aligned with business requirements and cloud‑native best practices. Establish foundations for high‑quality data engineering: CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation), automated testing, schema versioning, and data quality monitoring. Partner with Product, Analytics, and ML teams to define data contracts, SLAs, and governance standards that ensure reliability, consistency, and compliance. Build, mentor, and scale a multi‑disciplinary engineering organization — attracting top data engineers, infrastructure specialists, and SREs. Represent the data platform strategy to executive leadership, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology and business goals. Required Qualifications 20+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 10 years in data infrastructure or platform leadership roles. Proven record of leading large‑scale cloud migrations or greenfield cloud‑native data platform builds. In this role, you’ll focus on the operational backbone of content—how it is planned, created, reviewed, approved, published, maintained, and governed across digital and client-facing channels. You’ll partner closely with content, design, marketing, compliance, digital, and analytics teams to enable scalable, well-governed content delivery in a highly regulated yet agile environment. This is a hands-on, execution-oriented role centered on content governance, workflow design, taxonomy, operational agility, content UX enablement, and platform alignment—not content strategy or creative direction. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to complex workflows, and who takes pride in making content systems and processes work better for everyone involved. workflows, templates, and systems to reduce rework and risk Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to improve review efficiency while maintaining required controls Content Workflow and Lifecycle Management Own content workflows from intake and prioritization through creation, review, approval, publishing, updates, and archiving Standardize processes across content types and channels to improve consistency, speed, and transparency Track content demand, timelines, dependencies and capacity across teams and regions Identify bottlenecks and implement practical process improvements Content Production and Delivery Support Support high-volume content delivery across web, insights, campaigns, and client communications Manage editorial calendars and production schedules in partnership with content and marketing teams Ensure always-on content remains accurate, compliant, and up to date Coordinate with external agencies or vendors as needed Content Platforms and Taxonomy Partner with platform owners and marketing teams to ensure workflows, templates, DAM, and publishing practices support scalable, compliant, optimal content delivery Act as the content operations point of contact for Digital Asset Management (DAM) standards, metadata expectations, and lifecycle practices Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve and align workflows across AEM, Workfront, and Smartsheet, supporting intake, tracking, review, and delivery processes Provide content-specific requirements and feedback to inform system enhancements, workflow tooling, and usability improvements Support the design and consistent application of taxonomy, metadata, naming conventions, and publishing standards to improve content findability, reuse, and governance Measurement and Continuous Improvement Use data and feedback to inform workflow, tooling, and process improvements Stay current on content operations best practices and emerging capabilities, including automation and AI-enabled workflow support What We’re Looking For 7–10 years of experience in content operations, marketing operations, or digital content management Experience working in regulated environments, ideally financial services or asset management Hands-on experience with enterprise CMS and DAM platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager) Strong understanding of content governance, review processes, and compliance considerations Experience supporting workflow modernization or content operations improvement initiatives, especially through the use of automation and/or AI Knowledge of taxonomy, metadata, and content lifecycle management Familiarity with tools such as Workfront and Smartsheet for project intake, tracking, and workflow management Exposure to automation or AI-enabled content workflows Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple workstreams in a matrixed environment Familiarity with content UX best practices Why Join Us At State Street, the content and thought leadership team plays a critical role in supporting credibility, client trust, and commercial priorities. This role helps ensure content can scale efficiently without increasing risk, enabling teams to deliver timely, compliant, high-quality, engaging content across global channels. The Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) for Global Wealth Custody & Clearing will be responsible for driving and executing innovative global revenue growth strategies across our Wealth Services platform. This influential leadership position calls for a strategic, client-centric executive with deep expertise in wealth management, custody, and clearing solutions. The CRO will focus on delivering differentiated, scalable solutions to ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients and large enterprise wealth management firms, ensuring seamless integration across our global platforms and markets. This role requires a passion for delivering exceptional client outcomes, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and promoting our culture of innovation and inclusion. Key Responsibilities: Revenue Leadership: Develop, implement, and own a comprehensive global revenue strategy in alignment with Wealth Services’ objectives, with full accountability for achieving growth targets across domestic and international markets. Client Engagement: Cultivate and deepen strategic partnerships with UHNW clients and enterprise wealth management firms (assets > $20B), delivering customized custody, clearing, and investment solutions that meet evolving client needs. Sales Strategy: Champion the go-to-market approach for State Street’s global wealth offerings, leveraging strategic alliances—including our partnership with Apex Fintech Solutions—to broaden our reach and enhance the client experience. Co-lead joint initiatives with Apex to deliver integrated, end-to-end solutions that drive differentiation and client value. Expand relationships with existing institutional partners to unlock new revenue streams, while proactively identifying and engaging new enterprise wealth management prospects globally. Utilize market intelligence to identify and capitalize on opportunities in alternative investments, private credit solutions, and securities-based lending. Product & Platform Expertise: Apply expert knowledge of wealth management solutions—including CRD Wealth and third-party platform integrations—to support client transitions and drive operational excellence. Enterprise Integration: Demonstrate a strong understanding of enterprise client operating models, technology ecosystems, and compliance requirements to ensure efficient onboarding and integration across State Street’s platforms. Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Transition and Technology teams to deliver seamless, client-focused solutions and advance key revenue initiatives. Global Leadership & Representation: Serve as a brand ambassador for State Street, representing the organization at industry events, promoting thought leadership, and reinforcing our reputation as a trusted global partner. Travel: Willingness to travel internationally, as needed, to support client engagement and business development activities. Qualifications: 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in wealth management, custody, and clearing, with a demonstrated track record of global revenue growth and transformation. Deep domain expertise in addressing the complex needs of UHNW clients, alternative investments, private credit, securities-based lending, and large enterprise operations. Exceptional sales leadership skills, including the ability to design and execute enterprise-level sales strategies, negotiate complex transactions, and manage executive client relationships. Proficiency with CRD Wealth and other critical third-party platform integrations for enterprise wealth management. Strong strategic and analytical acumen, capable of translating vision into actionable business plans that drive measurable results. Proven ability to lead, inspire, and develop diverse global teams in a dynamic, matrixed organization. Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred. Key Attributes: Results-oriented, with an unwavering commitment to delivering client success and performance excellence. Innovative and forward-thinking, with the ability to anticipate market trends and adapt strategies to maintain a competitive edge. Collaborative leader who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment and aligns with State Street’s values of integrity, inclusion, and continuous improvement. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of process, data, and collaboration — someone who takes genuine satisfaction in making complex teams run more smoothly, and who brings intellectual curiosity about private markets and a desire to grow into a broader product career. The ideal candidate is equal parts analyst and operator: comfortable pulling and interpreting product usage data one hour, and coordinating a cross-functional release readiness review the next. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders to ensure our product team operates with clarity, discipline, and pace. You are a clear communicator, a reliable executor, and a proactive problem-solver who treats operational gaps as opportunities rather than obstacles. This role is an outstanding entry point into private markets product management — you will gain broad exposure to the full product lifecycle, our platform architecture, and the investment workflows that underpin one of the fastest-growing segments of the asset management industry.   What you will be responsible for As Product operations lead you will Support the end-to-end operational cadence of the Private Markets product team — including sprint planning coordination, backlog grooming support, release tracking, and cross-functional dependency management. • Own and maintain product documentation infrastructure: PRD templates, release notes, feature wikis, process playbooks, and onboarding guides for new team members. • Build and maintain product analytics dashboards to track feature adoption, user engagement, operational KPIs, and platform health metrics across the Private Markets suite. • Coordinate UAT cycles — scheduling sessions, tracking feedback, consolidating tester input, and ensuring defect resolution is documented and closed prior to release. • Act as the connective tissue between product, engineering, QA, and business stakeholders — managing meeting logistics, distributing action items, and following up on open decisions. • Support the product team in vendor and third-party integration management: tracking onboarding milestones, maintaining integration documentation, and coordinating technical reviews. • Assist in the preparation of executive-level product updates, roadmap presentations, and quarterly business reviews — synthesizing inputs from multiple product workstreams into clear, well-structured communications. • Conduct structured research and analysis to support competitive intelligence efforts, product benchmarking, and market landscape assessments. • Monitor and triage incoming product feedback from internal stakeholders and client-facing teams; route requests to the appropriate PM and maintain a structured feedback log. • Contribute to process improvement initiatives — identifying operational bottlenecks, proposing workflow enhancements, and helping institutionalize best practices across the product team. • Support onboarding of new product team members by maintaining role guides, tooling access checklists, and orientation materials. • Assist with data quality monitoring and reporting across key platform data domains, flagging anomalies and coordinating resolution with engineering and data teams. What we value o    Highly driven, determined & business oriented. o    Highly polished executive presence and sophistication to gain credibility with the firm's most senior professionals and provide leadership, guidance, and direction to a team. o    Demonstrated ability to deliver on assigned responsibilities through commitment to quality and attention to detail.   Education & Preferred Qualifications o    Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field. o    Coursework or demonstrated knowledge in financial markets, investment management, or data analysis is a strong plus. o    Advanced degree (MBA or MS) not required but considered favorably for candidates. o    5 -7 years of experience in product operations, business analysis, investment operations, project coordination, or a related role within financial services or technology. o    Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with data, building structured reports, and deriving actionable insights from product and operational metrics. o    Proficiency with product and project management tooling: Jira, Confluence, Notion, or equivalent platforms. o    Excellent written communication skills — able to produce clear documentation, concise meeting summaries, and well-structured executive updates. o    High attention to detail and strong organizational instincts; able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing quality. o    Collaborative and proactive working style; comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Preferred Qualifications o    Prior exposure to private markets, asset management, fund administration, or financial data platforms — either through direct work experience or academic focus. o    Familiarity with private markets systems and platforms such as Allvue, Juniper Square, Canoe, iLEVEL, Efront, or Dynamo. o    Experience with data visualization or analytics tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar. o    Basic proficiency in SQL or Python for data querying and analysis. o    Exposure to agile product development methodologies and sprint-based delivery processes. o    Experience supporting client-facing product communications, release documentation, or stakeholder reporting. o    Genuine interest in private markets, alternative investments, or enterprise financial technology — and a desire to grow into a product management career over time. Additional requirements o    Ability to travel as required for client engagements (-20%), including internationally   About State Street What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.   Work, Live and Grow. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you. This role will report into the Head of Index Market Data and will play a critical role in supporting the market data procurement and ongoing management lifecycle, with an initial focus on Index market data and ESG data responsibilities. The VP will operate as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders across State Street Investment Management and the broader enterprise, helping to drive transparency, commercial discipline, and strategic vendor outcomes. The successful candidate will be highly resourceful, intellectually curious, and motivated to drive change  — combining strong market data expertise with analytical rigor, relationship management, and executive presence in a global, virtual, and highly matrixed environment. What you will be responsible for Lead analysis and day‑to‑day governance support for key market data vendors aligned to Index and ESG priorities, including licensing constructs, renewals, service considerations, and commercial outcomes. Represent State Street Investment Management in enterprise‑wide discussions regarding market data vendors impacting Index and ESG, and coordinate inputs and follow‑through across stakeholders. Collaborate and partner with teams across Procurement, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Technology to ensure outcomes are commercially sound, operationally executable, and aligned to Investment Management requirements. Establish and manage strong relationships with Investment Management business teams (Index, ESG, Investments, Operations, Technology) to develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of market data products, services, and use cases. Drive transparency and structured insights by producing executive‑ready, decision‑focused analyses covering vendor economics, usage and demand signals, risks, and strategic options—translating complex inputs into clear recommendations. Support budgeting and spend management activities for Index and ESG market data in partnership with Finance, including scenario analysis and identification of cost optimization opportunities. Support demand management by collaborating with stakeholders to document pipelines, define priorities, and streamline the scope of market data needs through clear intake and governance practices. Contribute to the evolution of the Market Data operating model, including governance, reporting standards, stakeholder engagement rhythms, and repeatable ways of working that scale capability and reduce key‑person dependency. Operate effectively within a virtual, global organization — building influence through proactive communication, strong expectation management, and relationship‑led delivery across regions and functions. Contribute to forward looking initiatives and emerging data themes relevant to the market data function, including ESG innovation and evolving data and licensing models. What we value Ownership and accountability — taking responsibility for outcomes, following through on commitments, and proactively managing risks and expectations. Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning — a desire to understand how things work, ask thoughtful questions, and apply learning to improve decisions, processes, and outcomes. Solution orientation — approaching complexity with a mindset focused on options, paths forward, and practical execution rather than obstacles. Collaboration and relationship management — building trust across functions and geographies, working effectively in a matrixed and virtual environment, and strengthening partnerships over time. Clarity and rigor — the ability to synthesize complexity into clear, structured, executive‑ready insights that support informed decision‑making. Pace and discipline — delivering with urgency, maintaining high standards, and balancing strategic thinking with reliable execution. These skills will help you succeed in this role Demonstrated experience managing market data vendors and/or market data demand across business units, with a strong understanding of vendor commercials and licensing constructs. Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to create structured, compelling analyses for senior audiences. Strong strategic and commercial judgment, with the credibility and gravitas to engage effectively with senior stakeholders. Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce concise, executive‑ready materials and manage stakeholder expectations proactively. Comfort operating across ambiguity, balancing independent judgment with alignment to broader objectives and governance. Strong collaboration skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to navigate challenge constructively and lead with influence rather than authority. Execution discipline and reliability, with clear ownership, proactive updates, and consistent delivery of tangible work products. A team‑first mindset, focused on scalable ways of working, knowledge sharing, and building sustainable capability across the organization. Education & Preferred Qualifications 8–12+ years of experience in market data, vendor management, expense management, procurement partnering, investment operations, or a closely related business area. Asset Management experience preferred. Undergraduate degree required; advanced degree a plus. Strong MS Office skills preferred.
