Our Values If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. Who You Are As a Research team, we're evolving how we work, investing in Insights Fluency for all Justworkers, and building an operational foundation that can scale with us. You’ll build research systems that scale, working with significant autonomy, setting direction rather than just executing on it, and partnering closely with leadership to shape how insight drives decisions at Justworks for years to come. You're comfortable in the strategic weeds of research methodology, and you thrive in architecting the systems, tools, and workflows that make research and strategic insight possible at scale. You've built ResearchOps infrastructure before — and you know that the future isn't just about process documentation and vendor contracts. You approach every workflow with a clarifying question: what truly needs human judgment here, and what can be automated? The answer shapes everything — from how insights reach the people who need them, to how any Justworker can access what we know and act on it, to how we scale research and strategy from specialized practices into organization-wide capabilities. Your Success Profile What You Will Work On Transform our operational foundation to support research at scale Lead research operations. Define the vision, roadmap, and OKRs for Research & Insights operations in close partnership with the Senior Director. Identify where shared vs. dedicated infrastructure creates the most leverage, translate it into a sequenced operating plan you own end to end, and track metrics to demonstrate impact and drive improvement. Transform our participant recruitment infrastructure. Design and scale a system that gives researchers — and Justworkers Who Do Research (JWDR) — reliable, ethical, and efficient access to customers. Move us from ad hoc to repeatable to self-service. Harness our research community. Define where researchers' involvement creates the most leverage and build the coordination systems that make their contributions scalable. The goal: an ops practice owned by the whole community, not dependent on any one person. Define our research ethics and data governance standards. Own the frameworks, consent workflows, and privacy practices that ensure all research at Justworks meets our standards for participant trust and data protection. Automate everything that doesn't need a human. Design and build AI-powered agents and workflows that handle what doesn't require human expertise: surfacing prior research, routing insights, synthesizing patterns, scheduling participants, distributing the drumbeat of insight. The goal is to free researchers and Justworkers to focus on work only humans can do.   Increase insights fluency across the organization Build the operational backbone for our Insights Fluency program. EvolveDevelop the playbooks, tools, templates, and training that empower Justworkers across the company to conduct research responsibly and effectively. Connect every Justworker to insight and strategy. Build the channels, automations, and workflows that automatically route the right insight to the right person at the right time. Partner with Corporate Strategy so every Justworker understands where the company is headed — anchoring decisions in strategy, not just intuition. Establish and govern our Research Knowledge Orchestration system. Build a living repository that makes it easy for anyone to find what we know, with metadata frameworks and freshness policies that keep it trustworthy over time.   How You Will Do Your Work How results are achieved matters as much as the results themselves. Your foundational skills and attributes are anchored in: Strategic and systems thinking — You connect a recruiting pain point to a knowledge gap to a missed business decision and design a coherent operational response. You build for today and architect for scale. Consultative — You build relationships, understand problems, and co-design solutions through open-ended questions and active listening. You don't impose systems — you build them with the people who'll use them. Autonomous and self-directed — You operate with minimal oversight, proactively identifying what needs to happen and making it happen. You own the strategy and are accountable for outcomes. Stakeholder influence — You build trust and alignment across Research, Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and Procurement — making the case for infrastructure investment with data and story. Ethical practice — You bring care and rigor to participant privacy, data governance, and research ethics. Good operations protect people, not just processes. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people. We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you. We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. Our Values If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. Who You Are You're an operations leader who sees this moment in operations for what it is: a rare inflection point where AI and automation are reshaping what's possible, and where the leaders who move first will define the next generation of operational excellence. You bring deep expertise in standards, systems, and process design, paired with the vision to imagine what operations can become and the discipline to get there. You've built operational infrastructure before: the SOPs, controls, systems, KPI frameworks, and governance cadences that turn a high-performing team into a high-performing organization. You're a builder at heart, energized by creating structure where there isn't any, and you lead teams through ambiguity and change with conviction and clarity. You influence across the organization, earning trust, driving adoption, and making change stick even where you don't have direct authority. You're also a natural connector between Operations and the partners across Technology, Customer Success, Revenue, and Finance who are critical to making the company's transformation agenda real. Your Success Profile As the Senior Director of Central Operations, you will lead the transformation of our Operations organization at one of the most exciting moments in the function's history. You will build the operational backbone that sets the standards, systems, and capabilities for how the organization works, and you will lead the AI and automation agenda that will fundamentally reshape how operations gets done. This is a rare opportunity to stand up a centralized function from the ground up, shape its vision, and drive change that will be felt across every team in Operations. You will own a portfolio of centralized functions including operational excellence, data and KPIs, third-party systems, AI and automation transformation, and learning and development. You will elevate Central Operations as the strategic engine that raises the performance bar across the entire organization and positions Operations as a competitive advantage for the business. LEAD THE TRANSFORMATION AND AUTOMATION AGENDA Lead the Operations transformation agenda at a pivotal moment, with a particular focus on identifying, prioritizing, and deploying AI and automation solutions that fundamentally reshape how the organization operates. Reimagine long-standing workflows and unlock step-change improvements in efficiency, quality, and speed. Serve as the primary Operations liaison for company-wide automation and AI initiatives, partnering with Technology, Customer Success, Revenue, and Finance to identify shared opportunities, align on priorities, and ensure that what gets built reflects operational realities and scales across functions. Build a change management muscle within the org to ensure transformation sticks, focusing on how teams embrace and adopt change, not only what gets shipped. BUILD AND LEAD THE CENTRAL OPERATIONS TEAM Build, develop, and retain a lean, high-performing team, setting a high bar for excellence and creating an environment where people take ownership and do their best work. Set a clear strategic vision, aligning the team around shared goals and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. DRIVE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE ACROSS THE ORGANIZATION Define and maintain the standards framework for the Operations org, including SOPs, controls, and quality benchmarks, ensuring consistency and accountability across all ops teams. Drive continuous process improvement, identifying and closing gaps between how work is designed and how it gets done in practice. Build and manage a governance cadence that keeps standards current as the business evolves. OWN DATA, KPIs, AND OPERATIONAL REPORTING Own the KPI framework for Operations, including metric definitions, ownership, and target-setting in partnership with ops leadership. Ensure the org has timely, reliable, and actionable reporting, overseeing dashboards and data quality across operational functions. Serve as the authoritative source for how Operations measures success. GOVERN SYSTEMS AND TOOLS Own the Operations tool stack, including configuration, governance, vendor relationships, and license management across third-party platforms. Ensure tooling reflects and reinforces the processes the team standardizes, and that changes in process are reflected in how tools are configured. Evaluate and introduce new tools in partnership with IT and Engineering as the org's needs evolve. BUILD THE LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT FOUNDATION Own L&D for the Operations organization, including onboarding, skills development, manager training, and the capability programs needed to support transformation initiatives. Ensure that as tools and processes evolve, the team's skills evolve with them, preparing the org for a future where AI and automation are embedded in how work gets done. Build scalable L&D infrastructure rather than one-off programs. How You Will Do Your Work  As Senior Director of Central Operations, how results are achieved is as important as what you achieve. You'll demonstrate: Vision and Forward-Looking Leadership: You anticipate where operations is going before others see it and position your team to lead rather than react. You think in systems, connect near-term execution to long-term capability, and make bold bets on where the organization needs to go. Decisive, Data-Driven Leadership: You define what good looks like before measuring it. You use analytics and operational insights to set standards, track performance, and drive improvements across the org. You hold the line on data quality and metric integrity even when it's inconvenient. Change Management and Transformation: You know that shipping a solution is only half the job. You lead the shift toward automated, AI-enabled operations and bring teams along through change, building the adoption muscle that makes transformation stick. Horizontal Leadership and Influence: You drive outcomes across teams you don't own. You build credibility through expertise, earn trust through follow-through, and shape standards and practices org-wide through partnership rather than positional authority. Inclusive, Growth-Oriented Leadership: Foster psychological safety, encourage diverse perspectives, and develop emerging leaders across your team. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in operations, business operations, product, or a related function, with at least 3-5 years leading teams. Demonstrated success building operational infrastructure (SOPs, KPIs, controls frameworks) in a fast-growing or scaling organization. Proven track record leading transformation or automation initiatives, including hands-on experience evaluating, deploying, or governing AI or process automation tools in an operational context. Strong analytical skills with the ability to define metrics, oversee data quality, and turn reporting into actionable insights. Hands-on experience owning and governing operational tools and third-party platforms. Experience building or overseeing L&D programs, particularly in an operations context. Exceptional influencing and communication skills, with a proven ability to drive change across teams outside of direct ownership and influence at the executive level. Experience operating in a compliance-adjacent, regulated, or high-stakes service environment where quality and accuracy have direct customer or legal impact is a plus. Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent) is a plus. This role is based in our New York City headquarters.
